content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"search my tasks by title on the reporting page","so_that":"I can find a specific task in my report without scanning the full table","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lets the user type text to search tasks by their title. The backend report API accepts a title search value and returns only the matching tasks.","business_value":"Users can locate a single task quickly in a larger report by matching its title, as required by the 'Search: By Title' reporting requirement.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"the reporting page shows tasks and a title search input is visible","when":"the user enters a search text that exactly matches the title of one task and submits the search","then":"the backend report API is called with that search text and the table shows only the task(s) whose title contains it"},{"given":"the reporting page shows tasks","when":"the user enters a search text that matches no task title","then":"the table shows no rows and a message stating that no tasks match the search is displayed"},{"given":"a search text is entered on the reporting page","when":"the user clears the search input","then":"the backend report API is called without a title search value and the table shows all tasks again"},{"given":"the report API is running and the database holds tasks with titles","when":"a client calls the report API with a title search parameter","then":"the response contains only tasks whose Title matches the parameter and the response status is 200"}],"edge_cases":["Open question: whether the match is exact or partial (contains) is not stated in the PRD; this story assumes a partial match only if the team confirms it.","Open question: whether the match is case-sensitive is not stated in the PRD.","An empty search text is treated as no search; the PRD does not state this explicitly.","Search text containing only spaces: the PRD does not state whether it is trimmed or rejected.","Search combined with status, priority, date range, sorting or export filters: combined behaviour is owned by those stories and must be consistent with this search.","Search text containing special characters must be treated as plain text and must not change the query result (no injection)."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["Report API accepts an optional title search parameter and returns only tasks whose Title matches it.","Reporting page has a title search input that calls the API and shows the filtered table.","Empty result state for a search with no matches is shown on the page.","Automated tests cover exact match, partial match behaviour as decided, no match, and cleared search.","Open questions on exact versus partial match and case sensitivity are answered and recorded in the story notes.","Code reviewed and merged into the main branch."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-title-search-api","title":"[BE] Add title search parameter to the task report query","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the task report API so it accepts an optional title search value and filters the returned tasks by their Title field. Other report parameters (filtering, sorting, aggregation) belong to other stories and are not implemented here.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-8007d6b5"],"derived_reason":null,"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Report API accepts an optional title search parameter.","Query matches on the Title field of stored tasks.","Requests without the parameter return the same results as before.","Invalid parameter input returns the error response defined by the error handling approach.","Unit tests cover matching, empty value and no match."]},{"key_slug":"report-title-search-input","title":"[FE] Add title search input to the task reporting page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add a search input labelled By Title to the Task Reporting page.
